messages:
alex: quick sync — posting status for the kernel/kv sprint handoff. main ask: who owns the canary rollout gating and the metric thresholds?

maria: I can own the gating for the first canary (us-east). will need sam to sign off on perf regressions.

sam: ack. I can do the perf sign-off today if we have a reproducible harness. do we have the script?

jia: putting the harness link here: https://git.internal/runtimes/perf/harness — it has reproducer for 8K context. test flag: --kv-prefetch=on.

alex: perfect. maria, proposed thresholds: p95 targ <= 120ms token, p99 <= 250ms, error rate < 0.2%. can you confirm?

maria: those are fine for the first canary. we should have rollback triggers at p99 > 300ms or error rate > 0.5%.

leon: quick note on ownership: the kernel patch (PR #987) stays with eng-runtime kernel owners (me + alex). KV cache prefetch tuning (PR #994) is with eng-ml (sam/jia) but runtime infra will deploy.

sam: FYI PR #994 includes a new cache eviction param `--kv-evict-window=75`. default 100 -> lowers memory, slightly higher latency. we tested this in staging, latency +3% p95.

alex: thanks. can we include a toggle so canary uses `--kv-evict-window=90`? want a middle ground.

maria: yes, the canary config supports overrides. i'll add a canary override in the deploy manifest.

ops-bot: deploy plan created: canary/us-east-1 -> 3 hosts (c5-equivalent), health-check path /_healthz, rollout: linear 30% -> 60% -> 100% with 10m intervals.

jia: small request: add KV cache hit-rate telemetry to the canary dashboard. currently only latency + errors are shown. hit-rate + cold-spot ratio will help debug.

alex: good call. leon can you add the KV metrics to the perf dashboard and share the panel?

leon: on it. will add: kv_hit_rate, kv_cold_ratio, kv_prefetch_miss, kernel_token_ms. ETA 2h.

sam: pinging on the CI infra: CI job `perf-smoke` needs to run against the canary image tag. can someone add that trigger?

maria: i'll add the `perf-smoke` pipeline trigger in the deploy job. will also wire the log-level flag to capture `kv:debug` for the first two steps.

alex: code-review pings: alex -> leon on PR #987 (kernel patch) and sam -> maria on PR #994 (kv tweaks). can we mark these high priority? target merge before tomorrow EOD.

leon: reviewing now, left small comment about kernel spinlock docstring. should be quick.

sam: addressed comments in PR #994. left one question about unit test flakiness — @maria can you help run tests locally?

maria: yep, i'll run them and report back.

ops-bot: alert: staging flash tests passed (20/20).

alex: next milestone: canary -> start 2026-04-02 14:00 UTC. owners: maria (rollout), sam (perf sign-off), alex/leon (kernel rollback if needed). Dependencies: dashboard panels (leon), CI trigger (maria), canary config (maria).

jia: leaving a checklist in the issue: https://git.internal/runtimes/issues/3219 — add your initials when done.

sam: i'll be offline 10:30-12:30 UTC tomorrow but available after.

alex: thanks all. if nobody objects i'll kick the canary plan at 14:00 UTC on 2026-04-02. :thumbsup:

maria: +1

leon: +1

jia: +1

ops-bot: note: scheduled reminder will post 30m before rollout.
